protocol: Fixed all-Train refits 42/43/44 and identical retained parent. Each constructs its own parameters and chooses its own actions; no shared constructed states. Frozen encoder outputs may be reused only for identical complete observed views, with direct-forward equality checks. Enumerate all 16 manager availability masks for every retail episode and aggregate exact probabilities at 0, 0.1, 0.2. Require every seed to preserve generated/retail total loss, parameter/state/type/evidence accuracy, false handoffs, unnecessary/resolved requests and no-dropout recovery/necessary requests/handoff rate. Then freeze these candidates for one original Dev comparison.
devGate: Use all 258 original public Dev cases, 60 generated cases and 336 retail cases at all 16 response masks. Every fixed seed must improve strict TAT-QA answer accuracy, preserve other public retention metrics and pass the same sequential research retention gates. No fallback seed, epoch or inference mode selection on Dev. Main seed 42 fixed. Neither protected Test nor the frozen 27-source holdout is evaluated.
apiCorrection: Extend fixed per-field manager response conditions from retail Dev to Train/Dev. Cal/Test and nonretail remain rejected. Initial v1 stopped on the first Train retail mask before candidate evaluation. No model tensor or inference arithmetic changed; frozen head-training source preserved separately.
